title: Prove seven P104 hop bypasses lose main signal (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with an exact finite certificate, produced by Nick Petalas. Seven direct paid-hop bypasses in DreamingOfClouds' PR6621 word cannot preserve its main map using arbitrary initial frame-3 preparation and terminal frame-127 cleanup. No new kappa.

```text
A = bypass owned 772 at frame 520
B = bypass owned 771 at frame 534
C = bypass owned 771 at frame 117
rank(main-map defect) = A + bool(B or C)
```

The defect has an explicit decomposition into two independent main-input functionals. All seven nonempty subsets have rank one or two. Their combined potential moment saving is less than 24C <= 3/4 for 0<C<=1/32, so adding even one positive-rank paid job per native call consumes the entire gain while all other targets and paid work stay fixed. This does not assert that every changed acquisition requires such a job.

This answers a bounded construction branch of PR6621's second open question. The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19377657) initially sought a paid merge; the [scope update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19377762) records the negative result. The source construction and its claimed kappa are cited, not audited.

## Evidence and reproduction

- Before corrections, every bypass changes the source's 104-by-104 main map. The seven exact defect ranks are 1,1,2,1,2,1,2. Changed coefficient counts are 104,104,208,156,260,260,364.
- Full symbolic propagation agrees at every coefficient with backward source functionals and forward destination impulses. All later removed-read couplings vanish. Rational elimination corroborates the sharp rank formula and explicit two-coordinate witnesses.
- All seven modified words pass the declared common-chart, nested-transport and endpoint checks. Six semantic controls pass normally and with assertions disabled. Receipts are generated and bound to all nine package file hashes.
- Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64 passes both registered checks, about 1.31 and 1.30 seconds each, the package runner, source pins and committed-byte/source-history preflight. The final exact committed files also pass a Git-free standalone replay with the same receipt. The original source archive's API size/Git blob and nested retained-word equality were checked without executing predecessor code.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -B -W error research/p104-remaining-hop-signal/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -B -W error research/p104-remaining-hop-signal/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-remaining-hop-signal
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-remaining-hop-signal --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace that path. Expected direct marker: `PASS_REMAINING_HOP_MAIN_SIGNAL`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The correction phases have no chart changes and cannot access fields outside their chart. The result does not exclude interior repairs, retimed reads, different source representations, changed caller trees or arbitrary P104 words. The fourth intermediate owned stop, with an incoming update, is outside this read-only class. The rank-one correction count is algebraic, not a supplied physical acquisition tariff.

No selected cold replay, native phase replay, caller admission, compiler, precision/tape or analytic recovery proof was run. No complete rounded multiplication theorem or selected-frontier change is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The source-invoice question raised in PR6638 is not resolved here.

## Open next questions

1. Can an interior common chart provide either missing main functional without adding a paid job? Name an actual source/receiver pair and include every changed transport and productive target.
2. Can changing register 773's incoming frame-1031 source merge its paid hops? First derive its two-input boundary with arbitrary dirty state and a complete paid bill.

## Related open work

- PR6621 supplies the exact word and paid-merge construction lead. This adds a new obstruction for three further bypasses; it does not validate its complete invoice.
- PR6638 studies PR6621's invoice gate and retained receipt. This main-signal obstruction does not resolve that separate question or compare its caller numbers.
- PR6647 elides another owned carrier in the same PR6621 word while preserving its map and paid profile. These bypasses concern registers 771/772 and change the main map; no composed scalar total is claimed.
- PR6529 supplies the underlying scaled-transport word. Its two public transport merges are different edits from the owned stops considered here.
- PR6537 compresses PR6529's terminal correction. It preserves that correction's operator; this proof shows the specified terminal chart cannot repair these newly lost main outputs.
- PR6551 supplies the rebalanced retirement caller inherited by PR6621. That caller is neither changed nor replayed here.
- PR6670 studies price-null exchanges in a register-tax model. This result instead certifies the scalar defects of explicit read deletions in a fixed native word.

Completion refresh covered all 13 account open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. No additional PR studying these seven bypasses or their main-map defect ranks was found. No shared numerical disagreement was identified.

Credit DreamingOfClouds, Ali Romman, the PR6545 retirement construction, Erwan L., Rohan Arun and the full retained native/helper/compiler lineage. The predecessor notice is retained unchanged. Linear response and rank subadditivity are classical; the new seven-case obstruction, quantified correction proof, price bound and checker were produced by Nick Petalas.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `fdf61fb88720278557ed474d9ab931d928751f80` in [run 41671561731](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41671561731): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41671561731/job/126040989502) in 9m26s and [registered package replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41671561731/job/126046805489) in 1m58s. The completed checks were read once, and run metadata confirms the matching head and successful conclusion.

Hosted replay certifies execution of both registered normal and optimized checks. Local direct/registered replay, source-archive identity, standalone replay, metadata and committed-byte/source-history checks also passed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed; the scientific scope and unrun obligations above are unchanged.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. Only `research/p104-remaining-hop-signal/` is added.
